h1: Farisa Garden Hotel — A Modern Garden Boutique in Central Kalasin, Clean Rooms, Kind Owners
intro: If you want a stay in Kalasin town with a different feel from the usual plain hotel block, Farisa Garden Hotel is a modern garden boutique that reviewers keep mentioning for its cleanliness and kind owners · It sits on Thung Mon Bypass Road near the town centre, built by two sisters from Kalasin who combined their names into "Farisa" and added a small English-style garden their mother loved · 32 rooms, a lift, free parking and little garden nooks to photograph on each floor · What real reviews agree on is spacious, clean rooms, cold A/C, strong water pressure and warm, personal service · Rooms from approx ฿700/night

body.html: Farisa Garden Hotel is a boutique hotel in central Kalasin built to feel different from the usual town hotel · It was created by two sisters from Kalasin who built on the family's real-estate and restaurant business, combining their names into "Farisa" and adding a small English-style garden their mother loved to tend · The building is modern in style and stands prominently along Thung Mon Bypass Road near the town centre, with 32 rooms in total and small garden corners with seating on each floor for relaxing or taking photos.

Rooms come as twin, double and a larger Deluxe · Most real reviews say the rooms are spacious and clean, with cold air conditioning and strong water pressure · The decor is modern, with a small sofa, a flat-screen TV, a refrigerator, a kettle, a private bathroom and free toiletries · The Deluxe is a corner unit of about 37 sq m with a separate sitting area and a private balcony · Worth setting expectations for: the beds are on the firm side, and some rooms' balconies look out over the bypass road rather than the garden.
"Spacious, clean room, cold A/C and strong water pressure. The owner is so kind, the service is good, and there's parking with a guard watching it all night."

Service is what earns this hotel its warmest praise · The owners and staff are praised for being kind, friendly and helpful, with a 24-hour front desk, an executive lounge and a guard watching the car park overnight · There's a lift here, which sets it apart from many budget hotels in town and is handy if you have a lot of luggage or don't want stairs · Parking is free and Wi-Fi is free in every room.

Breakfast is served as a room-service set with several choices, from American-style dishes and burgers to rice plates and local favourites like sticky rice with grilled pork and a chilli dip, around ฿150 per set · The hotel sits on the bypass road that links the town to the routes out to regional attractions — you can drive into the centre and to the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument in a few minutes, and use it as a base for the Sirindhorn Museum (Dinosaur Town) or Lam Pao Dam · TripAdvisor ranks it #1 among Kalasin's guesthouses/inns, and the overall score from real reviews sits around 8.2.

To be honest, Farisa Garden sells a garden-boutique feel and warm, personal service, not a walk-everywhere central location · Because it's on the bypass road, it's most convenient if you drive yourself or rent a car · Some reviews feel it's a touch overpriced for the quality, which depends on the date and the room you book · But if you want a Kalasin town stay with spacious, clean rooms, a lift, free parking, a pretty garden feel and owners who run it themselves — this is a 3-star option many are happy with.

A tip from reading reviews here: if your budget can stretch, ask for the corner Deluxe, which is more spacious with a separate sitting area and a private balcony — worth the difference · Having your own car is the easiest way to stay here, with free parking and easy access off the bypass road · And if the view matters, ask for a room facing the garden rather than one whose balcony looks over the road · On long weekends and festivals, book ahead, as there are only 32 rooms.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Farisa Garden Hotel Kalasin

faq.q: Where is Farisa Garden Hotel · is it easy to reach?
faq.a: It's at 76 Thung Mon Bypass Road, Mueang District, in central Kalasin · It stands prominently on the bypass road, and you can drive into the centre and to the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument in about 5 minutes · It's easiest if you drive yourself, as there's free parking · Use it as a base for the Sirindhorn Museum (Dinosaur Town), about 30 minutes away, or Lam Pao Dam.

faq.q: How much does Farisa Garden Hotel cost · what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx ฿700/night for a Standard · There are double rooms, a Superior and a corner Deluxe of about 37 sq m — the most spacious, with a sitting area and a private balcony · Prices vary by date and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is Farisa Garden Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for self-drivers who want a Kalasin town stay with spacious, clean rooms, a lift, a garden-boutique feel and owners who run it themselves · Ideal for couples or a small family using Kalasin as a base for Dinosaur Town or Lam Pao Dam who value atmosphere and service.

faq.q: Are the rooms clean · what's the service like?
faq.a: Most real reviews say the rooms are spacious and clean, with cold A/C and strong water pressure, and that the owners and staff are kind and friendly · TripAdvisor ranks it #1 among Kalasin's guesthouses/inns · Worth knowing: the beds are on the firm side, and some rooms' balconies look over the bypass road.

faq.q: Is there a lift, parking and breakfast?
faq.a: The hotel has a passenger lift, free parking and a guard watching the car park overnight, unlike many budget hotels in town · Breakfast is served as a room-service set with several choices — American dishes, burgers, rice plates and local options like sticky rice with grilled pork — around ฿150 per set · There's also an executive lounge and a 24-hour front desk.

faq.q: Should I book ahead · what's the review score?
faq.a: The overall score is around 8.2 from real reviews · With only 32 rooms, it fills up fast on long weekends and festivals when many visit Kalasin, so book ahead and choose a free-cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm.
